task.question: What fine was issued to Amed S.F.K. by the Turkish Football Federation on January 29, 2026?
task.evidence: 29 January – The Turkish Football Federation issues a fine of 802,500 lira ($18,500) on Diyarbakır-based club Amed S.F.K. and suspends its president, Nahit Eren, on charges of "making ideological propaganda" after the club uploads a video of a woman having her hair braided amid similar acts by Kurds in protests against the 2026 northeastern Syria offensive.

answer: FINAL: The Turkish Football Federation issued a fine of 802,500 lira ($18,500) to Amed S.F.K. on January 29, 2026, and suspended its president Nahit Eren, on charges of "making ideological propaganda" after the club uploaded a video of a woman having her hair braided.
final: The Turkish Football Federation issued a fine of 802,500 lira ($18,500) to Amed S.F.K. on January 29, 2026, and suspended its president Nahit Eren, on charges of "making ideological propaganda" after the club uploaded a video of a woman having her hair braided.
